This '''garrison''' was an Imperial force located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nishr]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The force assigned to the [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] was under the command of [[Governor-General/Legends|Governor-General]] [[Vin Kollis]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the garrison's personnel fought against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Nishr Taskforce]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
